test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following can be a suitable title of the given passage?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Western domination."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage may discuss how Western powers exert their influence and control over other countries or regions.
 
• For instance, following the conclusion of the Cold War, the United States has clearly increased its influence in the Middle East and the Caucasus. In a way, the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait in August 1990 and the Gulf Crisis that followed gave the United States a chance to assert its hegemonic influence in the Middle East.
 
• In the years that followed, the United States' influence grew more in the absence of a competing power.
 
• Following the attacks of September 11, there were military operations in Afghanistan and an invasion of Iraq.
 
• The title of the given passage is about Western domination.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.
